title: Bigfoot 'hurls rocks' at terrified hunters in Texas forest
excerpt: A hunter in Texas claims he was chased through a dark forest by a Bigfoot which pelted him with rocks.
content:
A hunter in Texas claims he was chased through a dark forest by a Bigfoot which pelted him with rocks.

Did Bigfoot throw rocks at hunters in Texas?

Stephen Collins was out stalking deer in Houston County with his teenage son on November 14 when they were seemingly targeted by a mysterious creature which started throwing large stones at them while they were packing up a deer they had shot - and Stephen claims the beast followed them in the dark all the way back to their vehicle.

Reporting the incident to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization, Stephen wrote: "So my son who is 14 and myself were out hunting ...

"I shot a deer and cut it up and put it in my pack to haul out. While doing so, we decided to stop for a break and find my son a spot to hunt the next morning.

"While looking for a place for him to sit, a buck walked out. I alerted my son and he shot the deer. I could not carry both deer out so we drag his deer to the creek edge [Big Slough] and pack my deer to the truck.

"We grab something to eat and charge my phone. After that we proceeded to go back to his deer and get there about 20 minutes after dark."

Stephen claims this is the moment they were targeted by an unknown creature, adding: "We process the deer on the ground to put in our packs. While doing so, something threw a branch at us from across the creek and it hit the water.

"We didn't think anything of it. Just kept on processing the deer. We get packed out and start heading toward the truck. We walk the creek down to a crossing where we have to cross a log to get to the other side.

"As I stepped down to the log I see a rock fly through the air and hit the water next to us . I yelled out thinking it was someone who threw the rock.

"It did it a second time. I see a rock hit the water next to us. I yelled out again and heard nothing and proceed to cross. Entire time feeling like I was being watched."

Stephen claims whatever was throwing rocks at the pair then followed them as they hiked out of the forest, adding: "While making the rest of the hike out we had something following us.

"It was breaking branches and hit trees the entire time just out of our light. It continues this until I'm about 200 yards from my truck."

Stephen was left rattled by the encounter as he had previously seen a huge hairy beast in the same area back in 2009.

He added: "In February 2009 I was on that same forest driving home. I seen what I believed to be a Black man walking across the road.

"I hit my bright lights on him to see what the hell he was doing that time of night in the woods walking.

"What I seen I can't explain. It was covered in dark fur and was no man. It looked at me and kept walking into the woods and didn't miss a beat. I stayed out of the woods for years at dark."

BFRO Investigator Matthew Moneymaker looked into the report and concluded they were persued by a Sasquatch which was trying to "intimidate" them.

He wrote: "The possibilities are narrowed down only to two things - things that have arms and hands. No other animal species in North America has arms and hands that can throw rocks other than humans and sasquatches.

"Both the father and son heard menacing branch snapping and tree knocks following them on the way out ...

"This is a credible report, and there were two witnesses. The only reason it is a Class B report rather than a Class A report is because they didn't actually see the creature.

"Whereas Stephen's road crossing sighting in February of 2009, seven miles south of this location, would be Class A because he actually saw the creature.

"Given the history of sasquatch reports in this vicinity and remoteness of this location it is most likely that it was not a human harassing and stalking these two armed men.

"It was most likely a sasquatch that was trying to intimidate the human intruders."
